hints.text: Find the highest power on top and on the bottom. They match, so the answer is a ratio of leading coefficients.

explanation: Both top and bottom have degree $3$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Why the $-5x^2$ does not matter
steps: At $x = 1000$, the bottom is $2{,}000{,}000{,}000 - 5{,}000{,}000$: the $x^3$ term is $400$ times bigger than the $x^2$ term.
At $x = 1{,}000{,}000$ it is $400{,}000$ times bigger. Lower powers lose the race by a growing margin.
